ἔθελξε: θέλγω — charm, bewitch, enchant; aor. 3 sg.: ’enchanted’

ἥβη: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η for α)

ἰαίνετο: ἰαίνω — warm, heat; impf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was being warmed’

__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’)
__broaden__.γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth) · also with ἐκ: ’are born from, spring from’ (ἔκ τε κρηνέων … γίγνονται ’are born from springs’)
__broaden__.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure) · also masc. gen. sg. used of a goddess (the masc. form serves either sex): θεοῦ εὐνήν ’a goddess’s bed’
__broaden__.θυμοφθόρον: θυμοφθόρος — soul-destroying, heart-consuming; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄχος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κάματον: ’heart-consuming (weariness)’
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ)
__broaden__.κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Circe!’ (ὦ Κίρκη)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’)
__broaden__.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
__broaden__.πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’
__broaden__.σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’)
__broaden__.τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, bear, hold out; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you could endure’ · also + inf., ’bring oneself to, dare’ (τλαίης … ὀμόσσαι ’you would bring yourself to swear’)
__broaden__.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
__broaden__.ἔκπιον: ἐκπίνω — drink up, drain; aor. 3 pl. (ἔκ … πιον): ’they drank down’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same form): ’I drank down’
__broaden__.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’) · also of hurling a missile: ’hurled’ (ἧκε … κορυφὴν ὄρεος ’hurled the peak of a mountain’) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἧκε)
